description: UNOSAT and partner damage assessments: Iraq is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite-detected fires and environmental damage at and around Al Qayyarah, approximately 60 Km south of Mosul, Iraq. The main frame shows fires and the oil spill as seen in imagery collected between 23 December 2016 and 24 January 2017. Coverage: Iraq. The portal lists 28 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are complex emergency-conflict-security, geodata. It offers 6 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency shelter and critical facility planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
